body:
## Why (verified evidence)

In every consumer repo, a PR carrying `agent:auto` runs the registry default agent every round. The delegation policy never switches it, and the Orchestrator route-weights export never influences a decision. The consumer "Evaluate keepalive state" step exports none of the provider flags the policy reads, so every agent looks unavailable.

Verified on Workflows `main` at f0b58fc and on deployed consumer workflows, 2026-09-23:

- `.github/scripts/keepalive_loop.js:2722-2727` builds the policy's `secrets` map from exactly five env flags: `HAS_CODEX_AUTH`, `HAS_CLAUDE_AUTH`, `HAS_CLAUDE_OAUTH`, `HAS_CURSOR_AUTH` and `HAS_GEMINI_AUTH`.
- `templates/consumer-repo/.github/workflows/agents-81-gate-followups.yml:299-307`, the `evaluate` step, sets only `INPUT_PR_NUMBER`, `INPUT_FORCE_RETRY`, `INPUT_EXECUTION_PROFILE` and `ROUTE_WEIGHTS_URL`. The five flags exist only in the separate `preflight` job (:447-451), whose env never reaches this step.
- With an empty map, `decideNextAgent` returns `no-agents-available` at `.github/scripts/agent_delegation_policy.js:279-288`. That return comes before both the initial selection and the stall branch, and keepalive then keeps the default agent.
- Production log, stranske/Pension-Data run 30178556857 (PR #778): `agent:auto detected - running delegation policy`, then `No agents available (missing secrets)`, then `Delegation policy returned no agent: no-agents-available`.
- Deployed today: the `evaluate` step in Counter_Risk, Manager-Database, Trend_Model_Project, trip-planner, Fine-Art-Archive and Orchestrator exports 0 of the five flags.
- The root loop `.github/workflows/agents-keepalive-loop.yml:416-431` exports three of the five. Cursor and gemini read as unavailable there, although the route-weights export ranks cursor second for `implement`.
- Why it matters now: since 2026-09-22 the opener lane labels every PR it creates `agent:auto`, so that the route weights are consumed when a PR stalls. #3517's initial-selection fix also cannot take effect until this lands, because the early return precedes it.
- The previous task list for this issue named `HAS_OPENAI`, `HAS_ANTHROPIC`, `HAS_GEMINI`, `HAS_OPENROUTER` and `HAS_BEDROCK`. `keepalive_loop.js` reads none of those, so implementing it as written would not have changed behaviour.

## Tasks

- [ ] `templates/consumer-repo/.github/workflows/agents-81-gate-followups.yml:303-307`: add the five flags to the `evaluate` step's `env:`, exactly as the `preflight` job defines them at :447-451: `HAS_CODEX_AUTH: ${{ secrets.CODEX_AUTH_JSON != '' }}`, `HAS_CLAUDE_AUTH: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_AUTH_JSON != '' }}`, `HAS_CLAUDE_OAUTH: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN != '' }}`, `HAS_CURSOR_AUTH: ${{ secrets.CURSOR_API_KEY != '' }}` and `HAS_GEMINI_AUTH: ${{ secrets.GEMINI_API_KEY != '' }}`.
- [ ] `.github/workflows/agents-keepalive-loop.yml:429-431`: add `HAS_CURSOR_AUTH` and `HAS_GEMINI_AUTH` to the `evaluate` step, so the root loop exports the same five.
- [ ] Run `python scripts/check_template_drift.py --allowlist config/template-drift-allowlist.txt`, which is the Health 74 gate in `.github/workflows/health-74-template-drift.yml`. If it reports drift for either edited workflow, update that workflow's entry in `config/template-drift-allowlist.txt` in the same PR.
- [ ] Add the named test below to `tests/workflows/test_keepalive_workflow.py`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Named test `test_evaluate_steps_export_every_provider_flag_the_loop_reads` in `tests/workflows/test_keepalive_workflow.py`. It collects every `process.env.HAS_<NAME>` read in `.github/scripts/keepalive_loop.js` with a regex, so a future flag is covered without editing the test, and asserts that set equals the five names above. It then parses `templates/consumer-repo/.github/workflows/agents-81-gate-followups.yml` and `.github/workflows/agents-keepalive-loop.yml`. For each step whose script calls `evaluateKeepaliveLoop(`, it asserts every collected name is a key of that step's `env`. It also asserts exactly one such step exists per file.
- `python -m pytest tests/workflows/test_keepalive_workflow.py -q` passes.
- `node --test .github/scripts/__tests__/*.test.js` passes.
- Deliberate-break then revert: delete `HAS_CURSOR_AUTH` from the template `evaluate` step. The named test must FAIL, naming the file and the missing flag. Revert and it passes.

## Non-Goals

- Do NOT change `keepalive_loop.js`, `agent_delegation_policy.js` or `agent_registry.js`. Routing logic is #3517's scope.
- Do NOT expose secret values to the `evaluate` step. Only the `!= ''` booleans, which is what the `preflight` job already does.
- No scaffolding or TODO-only changes. Every task is a concrete edit verified by the gate above.

_Rewritten 2026-09-23 by an owner-directed session. The original body's task list named variables the loop never reads; the evidence above was re-measured from `main`, six deployed consumer workflows and one production run log._

title: [P1] Consumer keepalive evaluation exports no provider flags, so agent:auto always runs the default agent
